messages:
Rae: Promo paused by deploy-bot. Several staging runners are failing with tar unexpected EOF when extracting the python wheel. DeployBot created a hold.

DeployBot: Promote paused by deploy-bot at 3519991234. Reason: artifact-extract-truncated on checkout-canary. Link: https://ci.redwood/builds/20455 :no_entry_sign:

Olaf: snippet from runner-5:
```
ERROR tar: unexpected EOF
failed to extract /tmp/artifacts/checkout-2.1.0-py3.whl: expected 2048000, got 1536000
GET s3://ci-wheels/2026/03/22/checkout-2.1.0.whl returned shorter body
```

storage-bot: Observability: us-east-1 edge returned increased 499/5xx for object GETs 15:30-15:40 UTC. Ticket ST-1620 opened.

Rae: Change window ends in ~40m. Options: pin to last-good digest to unblock, or reupload artifact with new cache key and wait for verification. Pinning is fastest.

Olaf: I can reupload with VERIFY_UPLOAD=1 and CACHE_KEY_SUFFIX=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) while we pin. Recommend pin + parallel reupload.

CI-Runner-Bot: queued `/ci retry builds/20455 --only artifacts` (3 jobs).

ReleaseManager: If pinning, please add rollback steps to release notes and enable `artifact.extract.errors` alert for the cut window.

Rae: Manual promote API: `/deploy promote --env=staging --service=checkout --digest=sha256:goodold --reason=\"pin to known-good image to meet change window\"` (requires 2 approvals).

Olaf: +1; starting reupload now, pushing with multipart_threshold=8MB and checksum verify.

ReleaseManager: +1.

DeployBot: Promote executed: checkout (staging) -> sha256:goodold at 3519991289. Comment: pinned to unblock release.

Olaf: Reupload finished; local checksum verified. Triggering `ci-artifact-verify` with NO_CACHE=1. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/verify-9002

CI-Runner-Bot: verify-9002 started on runners 2,5,11.

Rae: Timeline: pin now, verify expected +7m, retarget canary +15-20m if green. If verify fails, keep pin and escalate storage team.

CI-Runner-Bot: verify-9002 passed on all runners.

Olaf: Verified green; will retarget after 10m smoke and remove pin. Filing short postmortem with storage team (ST-1620).

Rae: Unblock confirmed. Postmortem owners: Olaf (artifact pipeline), storage-team. Release note: "Temporary pin to known-good image due to truncated artifact downloads; retarget planned after verified reupload (ST-1620)." Thanks all. :thumbsup:
